engine.name: piper
engine.spanish_variant: es-MX (closest available to es-CO; NOT Colombian)

environment.command: python -m tts_bench.metrics run piper --mode warm --voice es_MX-claude-high

resources.ram_method: getrusage.ru_maxrss (bytes on darwin, divided by 1024*1024 to MiB)

background_load.note: 1-minute load average lags behind the run; treat the warning as indicative

resources.vram_note: no discrete GPU memory tool; unified memory is counted under RAM
